issues.on_page: Balance Sheet / Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balance - Governmental Fund (General Fund); Statement of Net Position column 'Governmental Activities'
issues.issue: The extractor rules list airport authorities as entirely business-type entities, but this report presents the airport as one governmental fund (modified accrual, fund balance). All lines and the top-level balances are recorded as governmental, which matches the report. It's a defensible judgment call, but it differs from the entity-type rule. Confirm which treatment is wanted.
